entries.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor command execution
entries.impact: The 2.3.4 vsftpd build distributed with a smiley-face backdoor can yield remote command execution.
entries.remediation: Remove vsftpd 2.3.4 and install a legitimate current release from a trusted vendor.

entries.title: OpenSSL Heartbleed information disclosure
entries.impact: Memory contents of the TLS process may be disclosed to a remote client.
entries.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later and rotate exposed credentials.

entries.title: Windows SMBv1 remote code execution (MS17-010)
entries.impact: Remote code execution against SMBv1 if the host is unpatched.
entries.remediation: Disable SMBv1 and apply Microsoft security bulletin MS17-010.

entries.title: OpenSSH user enumeration via authentication responses
entries.impact: A remote unauthenticated actor may determine whether a username exists.
